verdict.rationale: Vestd is a cap table and equity management platform, so exit waterfall modeling is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only digital cap table management, share issuance, option schemes and valuation services. Nothing describes exit waterfall analysis, proceeds per share class or stakeholder, multiple exit-value scenarios, or handling of liquidation preferences and participation.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation
